# A cost basis cost stated on a split whose account was never opened.
#
# 100.00 USD is bought for 135.00 CAD into `Assets:Bank:USD`, and the file
# opens no such account. With no account there is no currency to read the cost
# in, so the transaction is refused for the account itself rather than for the
# cost.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal giving `Assets:Bank:USD` as not found,
# and no transaction.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_stated_cost_is_refused_for_what_it_states.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 100 USD at 1.35"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "135.00"
		cost_basis_cost: "1.35"
	Assets:Bank -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-135.00"
